# Love Nature Krabi

> Love Nature Krabi Travel and Tour is a locally owned tour operator based in Ao Nang, Krabi, Thailand. Since 2022 the team of ten, led by founder Supaporn Sueakaew, has run shared day tours around Krabi: island trips by longtail boat and speedboat, mangrove kayaking, ATV rides and a cave day. Hotel pickup, a licensed guide and insurance are included on every tour.

## Business details

- Name: Love Nature Krabi Travel and Tour
- Address: 211 Ao Nang, Mueang Krabi District, Krabi 81000, Thailand
- Phone and WhatsApp: +66964075194
- Email: contact@lovenaturekrabi.com
- Opening hours: daily, 07:00 to 22:00 (Thailand time)
- Tourism licence: 33/10148
- Tours are booked online at https://lovenaturekrabi.jaithaitravel.com and paid at checkout. Cancellation is free up to 24 hours before the start time.
- The company does not run transfers; those are booked through Jai Thai Travel (https://www.jaithaitravel.com/transfers).

- [Home](https://lovenaturekrabi.com/): overview of the tours, who they suit, reviews and how booking works

- [Destinations](https://lovenaturekrabi.com/destinations): the ten places around Krabi with local advice on choosing between them
- [FAQs](https://lovenaturekrabi.com/faqs): booking, payment, cancellation, hotel pickup, weather, what to bring, children and safety
- [Contact](https://lovenaturekrabi.com/contact): WhatsApp, phone, email and a contact form
- [Blog](https://lovenaturekrabi.com/blog): the Krabi travel guide with practical local tips
